column1: # eot-pso-set v2: the pipelines the renderer builds ahead of the draws that
# use them. Generated by tools/pso/pso_derive.py from the paks and the
# captures; do not edit. Tab-separated records:
#   core   <id> <pipeline row (header columns): the state; shaders,
#          declaration, strides and polygon offset empty>
#   cap    <pipeline row>   the merged captures the set was made from
#          (the generator reads them back; not compiled in)
#          pkg: the packages whose load queues the row (|-joined), 0 = the boot;
#          bias 0 none, 1 the material's (m: offset m*1e-5, slope m*2),
#          source c captured (frame: first drawn; tags: the packages it was
#          drawn under; spec: the specialization bits it was drawn with),
#          d derived from the pak (likeliest first); msaa: how draws used it
#          under eot_msaa (bit 0 single-sample, bit 1 multisampled, 0 not
# 10265 captured pipelines (459 files): 8956 captured rows; 54106 derived from 230 paks; 119 cores, 110 declarations
# held-out levels: 2551/2826 drawn material pipelines predicted (90.3%), 20549 derived for those paks
# 4 states with a motion-vector form; rows by msaa use: 0 63062
